turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Do you need photos, and where do I send them?
Will I get a replacement or a refund?
Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
How long does the replacement take?
What if more than one item in my order is affected?
Can I keep the damaged item or must I ship it back?
turns.replyText: Let's ChatAgent said: Whether you need to ship the damaged item back or can keep it depends on the review by a Fit Stylist. After you report the damage and your order is assessed, you’ll receive clear instructions—sometimes you may be asked to return the item, and other times you may be allowed to keep it. To start the review, please provide your email address and either your order number or a description of the damaged item(s). This will help me look up your order and guide you through the next steps.DisclosureBy using this chat, you are accepting and consenting to the practices described in our privacy policy.Agent saidHi, beautiful! This is Barbra, your Thirdlove AI Stylist. How can I help you feel your best today?You saidMy order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?Agent saidI'm here to help with your damaged item. To get started, could you please provide your email address and either your order number or a description of the damaged item? This will help me look up your order and guide you through the next steps.You saidIs a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?Agent saidYes, a damaged item is handled differently from a normal return. When you report physical damage to a product, order contents, or shipping package, we prioritize resolving the issue and review the situation before any return, exchange, or refund options are discussed. We'll need to confirm your order details and gather information about the damage to ensure you get the right support.Could you please provide your email address and either your order number or a description of the damaged item? This will help me look up your order and assist you further.You saidDo you need photos, and where do I send them?Agent saidIf the damage is visible, yes, photos are required to help us review the issue. In this chat, you can upload clear photos of the damaged item—please lay it flat and show the problem area. If you’re unable to upload photos right now, you can email them to hello@thirdlove.com when you’re able.To move forward, could you please provide your email address and either your order number or a description of the damaged item? Once I have those details, I’ll guide you through the next steps.You saidWill I get a replacement or a refund?Agent saidThanks for asking! When you report a damaged item, the next step is to review your order and the damage. A Fit Stylist will assess your situation and determine whether a replacement, refund, or another solution is best. I’ll help you start this process—once your order and photos are reviewed, you’ll receive guidance on the outcome.Could you please provide your email address and either your order number or a description of the damaged item? That way, I can help you get started right away.You saidDo I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?Agent saidYou do not have to pay anything to return a damaged item. When you report a damaged product, Thirdlove reviews the situation and provides support without charging you for the return. Once your order and the damage are confirmed, a Fit Stylist will guide you through the next steps, including any return or replacement process.To get started, please provide your email address and either your order number or a description of the damaged item.
